subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should Lobster permanently consume a workflow resume capability after cancellation once the first resumed step has begun, while preserving it for cancellation during setup before any step starts?
rationale: The PR intentionally defines a user-visible retry and side-effect-replay boundary; earlier automated findings are resolved, but choosing that permanent lifecycle contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the execution-boundary contract
options.body: Keep setup-time cancellations retryable and consume workflow resume state after the first resumed step starts to prevent replay of possible side effects.

options.title: Preserve resumes on all cancellation
options.body: Keep every cancelled workflow resume retryable, accepting that additional replay-prevention design would be needed for post-start cancellation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the execution-boundary contract
recommendation.body: Keep setup-time cancellations retryable and consume workflow resume state after the first resumed step starts to prevent replay of possible side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed execution-boundary implementation and can explain its intended behavior, though current-main ownership could not be independently established.
